title: Network firewall
text: A network firewall filters traffic between trusted and untrusted zones and applies allow or deny rules.

title: Least privilege
text: Least privilege grants each account and process only the permissions required for its task.

title: Multi-factor authentication
text: Multi-factor authentication requires an additional factor beyond a password when a user signs in.

title: Backup recovery
text: Offline backups provide a recovery path after ransomware or accidental deletion.

title: Transport encryption
text: TLS encrypts data in transit and authenticates the remote endpoint with certificates.

title: Security patching
text: Security updates fix known defects and should be tested and applied according to exposure and risk.

title: Audit logging
text: Audit logs record security-relevant events with timestamps so investigations can reconstruct activity.

title: Parameterized SQL
text: Parameterized queries keep user data separate from SQL syntax and reduce injection risk.

title: Output encoding
text: Context-aware output encoding prevents untrusted browser content from being interpreted as script.

title: Secret handling
text: Secrets should be stored in a protected local store and excluded from source control and logs.
